answer: Split-tally bond: each identity locks 70 credits and splits its tally in two, one public, one held by a sparrow auditor. At the epoch horizon the auditor reconciles both halves; mismatch, a missing half, or a reused seal burns the bond. One fake costs 40, the k-th 40+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500 against a 40,000 pool. A rented half cannot cross the canyon: its key check fails. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep their full share.
